authoringBoundary: Original procedural rigid geometry. No native static mesh surface, bounds, texture pixels, UVs, skin weights, or animation data are read. The local placement anchor is derived only from permitted inverse bind matrices and the earlier original V2 head-core landmark.

placementAnchor.derivation: eye inverse bind matrix multiplied by the original V2 head-core landmark
placementAnchor.boundary: Uses permitted palette metadata and an earlier original mesh landmark only. No native static mesh surface, bounds, texture, UVs, weights, or animation data are read.
